The supported platform/architecture lookup, optional dependency entry check and successful resolution are successive requirements before placement, giving the stated four-condition conjunction (s9, s13, s11, s16).
Failed support, dependency-entry or resolution checks return before binary placement, so these checks enable file placement (s9, s13, s11, s18).
The checks activate installation for supported platforms with an available dependency, without analysis-detection conditions (s9, s13, s11).
The platform map chooses an OS/architecture-specific native binary, which main resolves and places as the command executable (f1:38, f1:198, f1:239).
Each failed check returns before the region; its placeBinary call reaches the declared function containing linkSync (s9, s13, s11, s18, s19, s17).
placeBinary has only the guarded call in main, and the file ends with main() without exports or alternate invocations of that function (f1:105, f1:239, f1:249).
linkSync is imported from fs and creates the destination file link; placeBinary also has copyFileSync fallbacks (f1:19; s17; f1:123).
